summary: A fragment from a fiction book (Book 4, part 25) set after a collapse in which the internet is barely running and survivors are isolated. Felix and Van meet Rosa, a woman who has been trading with neighbors in a shuttered area, including a restaurant group that makes soup. Rosa offers food and a chance to rest, and the conversation turns to whether survivors should band together or stay hidden, with Felix arguing for rebuilding something rather than letting it dwindle away.
one_line: Felix and Van trade with Rosa, a survivor in a quiet post-collapse town, and debate whether isolated people should band together.
key_facts: Felix introduces himself to Rosa and says he is with Van, who needs anti-histamines.
Rosa says the net is still up, and Felix replies that it is 'kind of' still up and has been kept online all week.
Rosa says she has at least ten neighbors and that the restaurant across the way makes a pretty good soup.
Rosa says the restaurant people cleaned her out of Sterno.
Rosa has set a broken wrist for a neighbor and offers Wonder Bread and peanut butter to Felix and Van.
Van offers to work as an assistant in exchange for help, describing them as committed workaholics looking to learn a trade.
Rosa says she does not need assistants but would not mind some company.
Felix noticed the restaurant people's noses wrinkle and found working plumbing in the back room, where Van took a sponge bath.
Rosa's name is Rosa, and she found a bottle of wine and disposable plastic cups in the housewares aisle.
Rosa says she expected helicopters, tanks or looters but found it is just quiet.
Rosa says she kept quiet to avoid attracting the wrong kind of attention.
Felix argues that the group is at a critical juncture and can either go down through negligence or try to build something better.
Rosa replies that the others may cut their throats, and Van agrees that she has a point.
Felix asks what they will do after they have read all the magazines and eaten all the potato chips.
